layoutContract.chartTray: collapsible bottom overlay, 52 px collapsed, 360 px / ≤58% open

mapContract.pins: one declared point-of-sale row per pin; zoom tiers 3 px / 5 px / full; context pins grey and logo-less; screen displacement with leader lines, source coordinates unchanged
mapContract.logos: ≤ 250, only at zoom ≥ 13.5 and only inside the focus
mapContract.venues: source building footprints/parts with explicit height provenance in map.activeLayer; unknown heights use a marked 3 m display slab
mapContract.neighborhoods: frozen named analytical road/river envelopes; no arbitrary radius components; no claimed consumer consensus

brandIdentity.fallback: Visible brand names and accessible marker labels retained; logos are identity, not a metric or endorsement
